list.title: Dikwadiso
list.empty: Ga go na dikwadiso tse di tshwanang le ditlhotlhi tseno.

override.title: Phimolo ya Motsamaisi
override.hint: Diphimolo ka metlha di kwalwa ka boitshupo jwa gago jwa motsamaisi le lebaka - ga di ke di didimala.
override.cancelBookingHint: Go khansela go tshwaya go buka le khomišene ya yona jaaka tse di khansetsweng, go busetsa bong jwa tiro kwa molekaneng, mme go letla moagi go buka ketapele eno gape.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: A o khansela peeletso eno? Khomišene ya yone le yone e a phimolwa. Se se kwadilwe ka leina la gago le lebaka.

detail.disputeOpen: Kganetsano ya bong e butswe mo moreking yo - molekane yo mongwe a re ke ya bone. E swetswa mo tsebeng ya Dikganetsano.

cancellation.title: Peeletso e khansetswe
cancellation.hint: Go buka le khomishene ya yone go a phimolwa; beng ba tshebetso ba boetse le molekane mme moahi a ka buka etello ena hape.

disputes.title: Dikgotlhang tsa Bong
disputes.hint: Molekane yo kwadiso ya gagwe e gannweng jaaka poeletso a ka ganetsa gore moreki ke mang. Boeletsa matlhakore ka bobedi mme o dire tshwetso.
disputes.empty: Ga go na dikganetsano ka seemo se.

detail.heldMissing: Kwadiso e e neng e tshwerwe ga e a bonwa.
detail.noteLabel: Ela tlhoko e e tlhalosang tshwetso (e a tlhokega)
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} o boloka khasetomara. Kganetsano e tswetswe mme ga go na sepe se sengwe se se fetogang.
detail.overturnEffect: Tshireletso ya poeletso ya {{holder}} e a fela jaanong mme khasetomara e kwadisitswe {{partner}} jaaka ikwadiso e ntšhwa.
